name: 27574 · Roxboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27574 (Roxboro) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27574 (Roxboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27574 (Roxboro) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
